codeReview.summary: Pass with one non-blocking contract issue. The feature adds first-class `flux auth phrase` and `flux auth diagnose` as thin CLI adapters over the existing auth helpers, preserves the normal and emergency phrase flows, keeps launcher and wallet guidance out of `--json` output, and returns actionable diagnose checks plus next steps without mutating persisted state. The added tests cover the main phrase, emergency, pretty-mode helper, auth-missing, and emergency-fallback paths for VAL-AUTH-003 and VAL-AUTH-004.

issues.description: When `flux auth diagnose` hits the no-base-URL path, `extractAuthDiagnoseBaseUrl` promotes the failed check detail (`"Base URL not set"`) into the top-level `baseUrl` field. That leaves automation consumers with an error string where a URL-or-null value is expected, which weakens the exact JSON contract on this edge case.
